candidates.change_summary: Replace the require check to allow anyone to call sudicideAnyone (removes owner restriction), so selfdestruct can be invoked by any caller.
Invert the require condition so only non-owners can call sudicideAnyone, preventing the original owner from self-destructing via this function.
Change the selfdestruct beneficiary to the stored owner rather than the caller, so contract funds are sent to owner on destruction.
Remove the selfdestruct call so calling sudicideAnyone no longer destroys the contract (observable state remains), while keeping the require.
Change the function to transfer funds to caller instead of self-destructing the contract, altering post-call contract existence and balances.
